class.name: DrawingTexture
class.description: Shows a drawing of [DrawingServer] as a [ViewportTexture] shows a viewport. A material names it like any other texture, in a scene or in code; whoever owns the drawing attaches it ([method attach_drawing]), as [LuaTextureNode] does. Its RID stays the same whether a drawing is attached or not, so a material showing it follows the drawing without being told.

method.name: attach_drawing
method.description: Shows [param drawing]; an empty RID shows nothing again. Called again after the drawing's material changed ([method DrawingServer.drawing_set_material]).

members.member: It holds its drawing upside down ([method DrawingServer.drawing_set_flip_y]) - for models whose texture coordinates count up from the bottom. A [LuaTextureNode] sets it on the drawing it creates.
The texture's size [lb]px[rb] - the size its owner draws at.
Whether the drawing it shows is transparent.
